messages:
Maya (Billing): Hey team — Soluna reported invoice preview 78321 is missing the GPU compute line, but the final invoice includes GPU hours. Also there's a duplicate preview show up as 78321-1 in their portal. Can someone investigate?
Jorge (Backend): Looking into logs now, I see `batch_invoice_worker` threw an error around the preview generation window: `ERROR empty_line_items for customer=soluna invoice=78321` — odd because compute usage exists in usage-store.
Priya (Engineering Ops): I noticed transient Stripe timeouts this morning. The preview generator retries and republishes on success; sounds like a race where the first run failed to attach computed lines, then a retry produced a preview and we ended up with two preview ids. :thinking_face:
InvoiceBot: [job 99321] preview created for customer=soluna invoice=78321-1 status=success (automated message)
Eli (Finance): Customer is blocked — they paused payment until we confirm the correct line items. Marking P1 for billing ops.
Jorge (Backend): Paste from the worker log snippet:
```
batch_invoice_worker.go:412: generatePreview(customer=soluna, window=2026-03-15T00:00Z->2026-03-15T04:00Z)
2026-03-15T02:14:07Z ERROR: fetch_usage timed out, returning empty set
2026-03-15T02:14:08Z WARN: retrying fetch_usage (attempt 2)
2026-03-15T02:14:09Z INFO: fetched usage (ret=ok) lines=[] // bug: aggregation returned empty
```
Jorge (Backend): That `lines=[]` is the kicker. Aggregation code dropped GPU line when the first fetch returned partial pages.
Maya (Billing): Can we patch to avoid publishing a preview if aggregation returns empty but retries later succeed? Also we should dedupe previews by idempotency key so duplicates don't appear to customers.
Priya (Engineering Ops): I'll open a quick PR to make preview publish transactional: require non-empty aggregated line set OR set a retry-with-backoff that fails the job (so no preview saved). Also adding a dedupe check by (customer_id, billing_window, idempotency_key). PR #412 created.
Eli (Finance): I'm going to offer a one-time credit to Soluna and draft the support reply. Please confirm expected correct invoice total after the rerun so I can include numbers.
Jorge (Backend): Quick test on staging after applying patch: replayed the same window and preview shows GPU line correctly, duplicate preview not created. Command I ran:
```
./bin/invoice_replay --customer soluna --start 2026-03-15 --end 2026-03-15 --env staging
```
Priya (Engineering Ops): I'll coordinate a 30min prod rollout -> run the replay script (dry-run then apply). Plan: deploy fix, wait 10m, dry-run, then run non-dry for affected window.
Maya (Billing): After rerun, also produce reconciliation report and export audit logs for 02:00-03:00Z windows for legal.
Eli (Finance): Acknowledged. I'll hold off credits until the corrected invoice is generated, then issue the credit and email Soluna.
Jorge (Backend): Patch queued for deploy to production in 27 minutes. Post-deploy I'll trigger the replay for 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z, and attach the regenerated PDF to this thread.
Maya (Billing): Thanks all — please ping here when the PDF is attached. Adding @support to follow up with the customer. :pray:
